career_ladder.salary_growth_trajectory: Direct recruitment through the Tripura Police Constable Examination appoints personnel as Police Constable (Men & Women, Executive Cadre) and Rifleman in the Tripura State Rifles (TSR) in Tripura State Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules 2018 Pay Matrix Level 6 (₹20,900 – ₹66,400). Recruits complete basic training at the Police Training Academy (KTDS PTA), Narsingarh, Agartala. Progression takes place through departmental promotion examinations and seniority to Head Constable (Level 7, ₹22,900 – ₹72,700), Assistant Sub-Inspector (ASI, Level 8, ₹26,100 – ₹82,800), Sub-Inspector of Police (SI, Level 10, ₹34,700 – ₹1,10,000), Inspector of Police (Level 12, ₹42,900 – ₹1,35,000), and Gazetted Deputy Superintendent of Police (DSP, Level 14, ₹54,000 – ₹1,71,000) in the Tripura Police Service (TPS).

official_perks.description: Dearness Allowance at 58% of Basic Pay (₹12,122 per month on entry basic of ₹20,900 as of 01.07.2025) as sanctioned by Finance Department, Government of Tripura.
HRA at 8% of Basic Pay (₹1,672 per month) in Agartala and district stations, or rent-free government police accommodation.
Monthly police ration allowance (₹2,000 per month) for uniformed executive staff.
Annual uniform grant and monthly kit maintenance allowance (approx ₹1,500 per month) under state police regulations.
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% Government matching contribution and Mukhyamantri Jan Arogya Yojana (MMJAY) / State Medical Attendance Reimbursement.
